conf.description: FireEye NX/CM nx-alert LEEF notification feed: header split + named key=value attribute decode (LEEF names fields explicitly, no cs/cn slot ambiguity) per recommendations.direct.cribl, keep _raw.

conf.comment: fireeye / nx-alert / syslog-leef. LEEF:1.0 header (Version|Vendor|Product|Version|EventID|) then key=value attrs, delimiter tab or caret per site (work order enable notes say both occur) - attrs are tokenized with a whitespace/caret lookahead so embedded spaces in cncChannel/request survive. eventType (header field 5) is mapped to event.action by analogy with the sibling CEF format's header name field; it is not a fields[] row in the work order, flagged in README. No severity/action field is documented for LEEF in the work order, so event.severity/event.type are left unmapped on this transport (a gap in the map, not this parser).

functions.description: split the 5 pipe-delimited LEEF header fields plus the trailing attribute blob (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since unanchored)
tokenize the named-key attribute blob, map every documented key to ECS/custom targets, best-effort devTime parse (no devTimeFormat row supplied), dataset/category tags, cleanup
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
